_comment: M9 rare-item paths (stream C): boss first-kill drops, treasure maps and caches, region exclusives. See systems/loot.ts. Items marked lootOnly in items.json only come from here.
firstKillLog: {boss} was carrying {item}. HALCY has logged it as a first-time acquisition.
repeatLog: {boss} had another {item}. Apparently they come in sets.

maps._comment: Rolled on every item find (about hourly). digChance is rolled on every encounter once the explorer has been out digMinMinute minutes in a region with an undug map.
foundLog: Found a map folded into a boot. Someone marked an X and wrote 'DO NOT TELL DEREK'. I am telling the homestead.
A map, drawn on the back of a Halcyon safety poster. There is an X. There is always an X.
Traded a stranger two buttons for a map. The X is circled three times, which I take as a guarantee.

caches.name: The Drover's Stash
caches.text: Dug under the dead cottonwood, just like the map said. A tin trunk, a pick, and a note: 'Took the long way home.'

caches.name: The Root Cellar
caches.text: The X was a cellar door. Under it: jars of pickles, a rocking chair and a very old woman who asked whether I had eaten. She is coming home with me. She says it was her idea.

caches.name: Halcyon Survey Capsule
caches.text: Dug a Halcyon survey capsule out of the glass. Sealed, labelled, and filed under 'Open After The Glare'. Close enough.

caches.name: The Shard Hoard
caches.text: Something had been hoarding shiny things under a crystal ledge. It had good taste and has, fortunately, moved out.

caches.name: The Pumphouse Strongbox
caches.text: Held my breath, went down, came up with a strongbox from the old pumphouse. Inside, bone dry: a Halcyon Peacemaker and a very smug gasket.

regionExclusives._comment: Rolled on every item find in that region. These items are lootOnly, so nothing else drops them.

achievements.name: Pest Control, Crystalline
achievements.description: Squash a glassback swarm before it wanders off.

achievements.name: Apex Paperwork
achievements.description: Bring down a Mauler inside the homestead.

achievements.name: Top of the Food Chain
achievements.description: Bring down 5 Maulers inside the homestead.

achievements.name: Local Colour
achievements.description: Find 3 region-exclusive items in the Glarelands.
